text:
sam.support: FYI — Acme reported 401 on /v1/generate after swapping keys during onboarding. Error: invalid_api_key. They pasted the 'Signing secret' from Settings > Integrations.

sam.support: curl they ran:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer WH_abc123def456" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

emma-se: That WH_ prefix is the webhook signing token — not a valid API key for the public API. API keys start with RK_ (or similar). 401 is expected. We should update onboarding doc to call out the two tokens.

nitin-eng: Confirmed from logs: client auth failed with type=invalid_api_key, source=auth-service. We can detect common webhook prefix and return guidance in the response body briefly. Filed SUP-3421.

ops-bot: Ticket SUP-3421 created by nitin-eng — title: 'Improve error message when webhook token used as API key'.

sam.support: Customer followed up, swapped to the Dashboard > API keys > Create key, retried and now success. Closing on our side. :tada:

emma-se: Nice. Small doc update and maybe add an alert in the dashboard UI copy.

nitin-eng: I'll add a short check in auth layer to map WH_ prefix to helpful error message next sprint.

sam.support: Thanks all — marking resolved.
